_about: Words and timings of the Round2 PS4 tile (tile 0.16+, Karen's save screen v2, 27 Nov). Plain letters only (A-Z, numbers, ' " - . , ! ? | [ ]) - anything else is dropped because the TV can't draw it. {crew} = the crew's name, {room} = the room's name, [PS] = the round PS button. In a title with {crew}, the crew's name is bright and the words around it are dim on their own line. Steps: 'main line|small line'. Times in seconds: all-set screen 0.5-5, what-happens-next screen 3-20. A wrong file = the tile keeps its own words. Some keys have old names from tile 0.15 - the group they're in says what they do now.
